title: Forecast methodology
content: Demand forecasts are produced monthly per geography, customer and SKU using an ensemble of exponential smoothing and gradient boosted models. Forecasts include a P10-P90 prediction interval.

title: Forecast accuracy (MAPE)
content: Forecast accuracy is reported as MAPE (mean absolute percentage error). A MAPE below 15 percent is considered good for SKU-level monthly forecasts.

title: Variance thresholds
content: Variance is actuals minus forecast. Variances above 10 percent in absolute terms for a period are flagged for review by the demand planning team.

title: Driver contributions
content: Explainability uses SHAP-style feature contributions. Typical drivers include price, promotions, seasonality, distribution and macro-economic indicators.
